shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; git log --stat | head -50; find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -50

cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts .gitignore; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components | tr '\n' ' '

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm && ls components/controls hooks 2>/dev/null | tr '\n' ' '; echo; cat components/Avatar/types/*.d.ts | head -80; echo ----; cat components/Switch/Switch.d.ts components/Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts; echo ---; grep -rn "useFileInput" hooks/index.d.ts; cat hooks/useFileInput/useFileInput.d.ts

cat components/Avatar/AvatarImage/types.d.ts components/Avatar/AvatarText/types.d.ts; cat components/Select/types.d.ts | head -150; cat components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts; cat components/controls/types.d.ts | head -60; cat components/ControlLabel/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; ls components/layout components/Card; cat components/types.d.ts | head -40

cat components/Card/Card.d.ts | head -40; grep -n "variant\|TextProps\|color" components/Text/Text.d.ts | head; grep -rn "TEXT_VARIANTS\|'body-1'" components/Text/text/text.d.ts | head -5; cat components/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts | grep -n "gap\|direction\|alignItems\|justify\|spacing" | head; cat components/Alert/types.d.ts | head -40; grep -n "view\|loading\|type\b\|type?" components/Button/Button.d.ts | head -20

ls node_modules | grep -i -E "playwright|puppeteer"; which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; npx --no-install playwright --version 2>&1 | head -2
